summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 based on two alleged eyewitnesses; material omissions in testimony (distance, sequence of stabbings, presence of others); failure to report to police; non-examination of key witnesses; recovery under Evidence Act s.27 insufficient without corroboration; standard of proof: beyond reasonable doubt not met; conviction quashed; accused acquitted.
legal_provisions_cited: Manoj Kumar Soni v. State of M.P.
Edakkandi Dineshan alias P. Dineshan & Ors. v. State of Kerala
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted and entitled to immediate release.
